static_functional_definition_revision.scope_note: After the unchanged source recipe builds the exact pinned PCM with its already locked googletest supplement, run the five upstream numeric-input parsing unit tests from the retained build tree. This checks decimal/hex conversion, uint64 boundary values, whitespace and malformed-input rejection. It does not qualify physical PMU/MSR/PCI counter collection, and does not claim the test executable is installed in the exported prefix.

source_evidence.finding: Root adds tests unconditionally; the original recipe builds all targets in {build}/native.
Tests use ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/tests; existing locked googletest header enables utests.
Creates read-number-utest in bin/tests/utests and links GTest::gtest_main/GTest::gmock_main/PCM_STATIC.
Exactly five ReadNumberTest cases use EXPECT_EQ and EXPECT_THROW on pcm::read_number; no hardware collector invoked.
Actual pinned output implementation prints [  PASSED  ] then FormatTestCount(successful_test_count), then a period; expected summary therefore derives from exact five declared upstream tests.
